# 1 Enoch Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** After all this, the whole earth will be farmed in righteousness — planted with trees everywhere and overflowing with blessing.

**2** Every kind of beautiful, fruitful tree will be planted across the land, and grapevines will be planted everywhere. Every vine will produce wine beyond measure. Every seed sown will yield ten thousand times over, and every measure of olives pressed will fill ten jars with oil.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Chapter 11 is a two-verse vision of the renewed earth — a brief, brilliant flash of paradise after the darkness of the Watcher judgment. The hyperbolic multiplication (ten thousand grains per seed, ten oil-presses per measure of olives) is a joyful eschatological idiom. The dynamic rendering captures the abundance and joy of this vision before the narrative pivots to Enoch's personal call in ch. 12.*
